poster_profile_bio_excerpt: CKD warrior. Trying to live with this. Twin Cities, MN. Opinions my own.
post_text: for anyone reading this who is on solivian for ckd — i've been on it 14 months and my legs have been so swollen i can't fit in my work shoes anymore. doctor says it's a known side effect but they wont change my dose because my kidney numbers are 'better'. anyone else dealing with this???
thread_replies_relevant: @somebody_else: same here lol. started 2024. ankles are huge. my doc said the same
@notreallygiven: I had to come off solivian after 6 months because of fluid in lungs. you should ask about that
@kidneywarrior_jr (replying): i did pulmonary function test last month, normal. just the swelling. its embarassing
@another_user: have you tried diuretics? compression socks?
